problems.problem: The burnt-sienna disc renders almost concentric with the bottle axis (visible disc edges at roughly x=280 and x=800, centre near x=540, y=710), so the declared 'low and off-centre setting sun' reads as a symmetric halo; the asymmetric tension that gives the concept its signal-poster character is lost.

The sienna registration rule (decoration at y=415, width 173) sits only ~5px above the cap top (product_bbox top y=418), so the closing mark of the type band visually collides with the flacon silhouette instead of separating monument band from object.

Hierarchy inside the upper band is loose: the title block ends at y=267 but the subtitle starts at y=350, an ~83px void between name and 'EAU DE PARFUM' that reads as an accidental gap rather than a stacked monument band.

The gouache field is perfectly even and textureless; against references 3-5 (which all carry directional light, cast shadow or reflective ground) the backdrop reads as a flat digital fill with a pasted cutout, weakening the printed-paper material story.

Contact detail crop [259,1171,821,1421] confirms a real soft contact shadow under the base at offset_y=0 (correct, not floating), but at opacity 0.35 with blur 10 the anchoring smear is fainter than the crisp silhouette discipline elsewhere; the flacon's grounding cue is present yet under-weighted.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte gouache-painted paper field in saturated marigold ochre with faint dry-brush paper grain, one large hard-edge flat circle in deep burnt sienna centred left of middle and low in the frame, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, no horizon, no objects
